 Oral Order

Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned APP appearing for the State and the learned counsel for the O.P. No. 02; Sri Sunil Kumar Singh.
2.

This is an application for quashing of the order dated 04.02.2017 passed by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Bhagalpur in Complaint Case No. 1263 of 2016 by which cognizance has been taken against the petitioner and others for the offences punishable under Sections 323, 341 & 498A of the Indian Penal Code and Section  of the DP Act.
3. Learned counsels for both the parties have relied upon the Divorce Petition vide Matrimonial (Divorce) Case No. Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.47791 of 2019(2) dt.10-04-2025 34 of 2025.
4. Paragraphs L and M of the Divorce Petition vide Matrimonial (Divorce) Case No. 34 of 2025 read as follows:-

M) That all the cases Complaint Case No. 1263/2016 and Maintenance Case No.

sentences.text: Pursuant to the statements made in the divorce petition, this application is allowed.

Accordingly,
the order dated 04.02.2017 passed by the learned Sub-Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Bhagalpur in Complaint Case No. 1263 of 2016 is hereby quashed.

(Sandeep Kumar, J) Shishir/-
